## Replacement Toothbrush Heads for Oral-B and Braun Electric Toothbrushes

Keep your electric toothbrush working at its best with these replacement brush heads, compatible with Braun Oral-B electric toothbrushes. This four-count pack makes it easy to refresh your routine without extra trips to the store.

## Gentle Bristles, Effective Cleaning

Extra-soft bristles feel gentle on your gums and teeth. The ergonomic design helps remove plaque, and regular brushing with healthy habits can help decrease the chance of gingivitis.

## Care for the Whole Household

These brush heads are designed for women, men, and kids. Each one is a simple swap, so everyone in your home can keep up with daily oral hygiene.

## Stay on Schedule

Dentists recommend changing your toothbrush every one to three months. With four heads in every pack, you have a steady supply to keep your routine consistent.

Every purchase is backed by a 100% satisfaction guarantee, or your money back. Add these replacement brush heads to your cart today and give your smile the care it deserves.
